usage: A common noun for bamboo, a plant with hard hollow stems that grows in clumps.
Used in everyday nature and gardening contexts, especially when talking about bamboo groves, garden plants, or materials made from bamboo.
Can appear before other words to form compounds and set phrases, so learners should treat it as a basic building block word.
Very common in written and spoken Cantonese, and easy to use in simple descriptions of plants and natural surroundings.
